notes: The 🔬's data check now inspects up to 8 disputed shares instead of 3 — enough to cover BOTH halves of each disagreeing pair, so it can no longer certify one share as clean while never looking at the share it allegedly outranked. The device self-check now also covers the day's change-% (built from a different field than price and volume, and the one most reports actually rank on). And the wording is more careful: a share is 'certified clean'; a disagreement is only called a true rule difference when both shares involved are.
